comparison.objective: Straighten a training doll’s sprung legs while closing an infantometer footboard.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained bimanual limb restraint and measurement-board adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Doll straightened, footboard left at the reading, and robot released; numeric reading tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Holding compliant limbs for measurement differs from screw/jam-nut countertorque and retained gripper cycles.
